modelDescription: Warne Mountain Tech is the ultimate lightweight precision scope mounting system. Mil-Spec Hardcoat Anodized finish for abrasion and corrosion resistance; black zinc coated hardware for Element Proof protection and self centering tapered T-15 Torx screws. Fits Picatinny/Weaver style mounts and are NATO-STANAG compatible.
